reason: Clearing settled dust from the array seems like a useful first step toward restoring solar power and restarting services.
expectation: I expect the brush to clean the panels and improve their output, though other steps may be needed to restore power.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also seems relevant, but the array appears to be the immediate source of power for restarting services.

effect: Cleaning the array restored solar supply, so I can now reconnect the discovery case.
reaction: It is satisfying to have solar power available again.
reason: The core needs continuous refrigeration, so reconnecting its case to the restored supply seems useful.
expectation: I expect the case refrigerator to switch from backup to solar power, though the result may involve another connection step.

alternatives.reason: Restoring the water line also supports essential services, but I want to reconnect the cold case first.

effect: The discovery case is now on station power, so I can turn to restoring the water line.
reaction: It is reassuring that the core's case has a power connection again.
reason: The drained water line needs to be brought back into service, and drinking water is compatible with it.
expectation: I expect the line to be refilled or otherwise restored, though I am unsure whether additional checks will be needed.

alternatives.reason: Moving the lettuce back toward the window seems useful now that sunlight has returned, but restoring water seems more urgent.

effect: The line is primed and water reaches the tap, completing the essential-services goal. The next goal is to return both troughs to the window.
reaction: The pump pushing air out makes the line's restart clearer.
reason: The lettuce trough needs to return to the window, so I will move it first.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed on the window growing shelf, with the potato trough still to follow.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to return; either order seems reasonable.

effect: The lettuce is at the window shelf; the potato trough still needs to be moved.
reaction: Nothing notable; the placement happened as expected.
reason: Moving the potato trough is the only offered gameplay action and should complete the current goal.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to join the lettuce at the window and the goal to be completed.

effect: The potato trough joined the lettuce at the window, completing the chapter.
reaction: The placement happened as expected; nothing else stood out.

mostWorthwhile.text: Priming the exterior water line was most worthwhile: the explanation that the pump pushed air out made the service restart clearer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs felt repetitive; each was a straightforward placement.

surprise.text: The pump pushing air out of the line clarified what priming accomplished.

arbitrary.text: No action felt without a clear purpose, though the two separate trough placements offered little meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens to the discovery in the ice, though this chapter's straightforward restoration steps were less engaging.
